title: Whilce Portacio
description: According to Whilce Portacio, "Yoda is that quiet 'old man' no one gave a second glance, yet if you did, you'd see eyes that opened onto worlds of wonder..." Portacio started his artistic life as a humble activities poster designer, and fire prevention artist...no onc having a clue to the true demented and dark aesthetic nature that lurked within his brain pan. An unsuspecting Carl Potts gave him his big break inking LONGSHOT, ALIEN LEGION and ALPHA FLIGHT. Finally, Portacio was awarded the penciling reins on PUNISHER, X-FACTOR and UNCANNY X-MEN. Current Portacio projects include WETWORKS for Image and a DRACULA sub-set in the UNIVERSAL MONSTERS ILLUSTRATED card series for Topps.
